component.name: Title
component.description: Semantic heading component with size, line height, and terminal font variants (h1-h6).

behavior.map: Semantic heading component. Renders as h1-h6 via 'level' prop (1-6) or 'as' prop. Size variants (XXS-XXL, default L). Line height variants (tight-loose). Use 'level' for semantic HTML, 'as' to override element.
behavior.rendering: Always renders heading with configured element, size, and lineHeight.

layout: Element type determined by 'level' or 'as' prop.
nesting: Headings should follow semantic hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3...).

accessibility.keyboard: Non-interactive (skip links may target via id).
accessibility.contrast: Inherits color (ensure parent provides sufficient contrast).

responsiveness.rules: Heading text wraps based on container width. Consider reducing size on mobile.

usageNotes: Use 'level' prop (1-6) for semantic HTML headings.
Use 'as' prop to override element (e.g., level=2 but as='h3').
Default: h1 element (or h{level} if level provided).
Size variants: XXS, XS, S, M, L (default), XL, XXL.
Line height variants: tight, snug, normal, relaxed, loose.
Supports all HTML heading attributes via rest props.
Color inherited from parent (no color prop).
Use for page titles, section headings, card titles.
Follow semantic heading hierarchy for accessibility.
